findings.reason: Cooked food in bowls and cut produce such as cabbage are left uncovered inside the refrigerator.
The sink basin contains dirty dishes and cookware, and no dedicated clean handwashing basin is available.
Waste is kept in an open black plastic bag directly on the floor without a rigid lidded dustbin.
The cooktop surface has noticeable food spills and residue, and the wooden chopping board exhibits deep staining and wear.
The Patanjali Cow's Ghee carton displays an expiry date in July (JUL 26 or earlier), which has lapsed compared to today's date of 2026-10-18.

liveness.observed: Hand rested on the edge of the stovetop with 5 fingers touching the counter surface rather than held upright in front of the stove.

continuousTake.detail: The video is a single, uninterrupted continuous take with no cuts, jumps, or editing artifacts.

sameKitchenAsReference.detail: No previous reference exists as this is the first verified audit.

activityMatchesOrders.detail: Kitchen displays clear signs of ongoing activity matching the order volume, including used utensils in the sink, cooking vessels on the stove, cutting board with a knife, opened food items, and trash in the waste bag.

propsSuspected.detail: No artificial props or staging detected; items, pantry supplies, and kitchenware show genuine everyday usage.

integrity.kitchenSummary: A domestic/cloud kitchen environment featuring a stocked refrigerator, a sink with used utensils, a trash bag, a two-burner gas stove with pans and a tea vessel, spice shelving, a microwave, and checked dairy products.

en: Cover all prepared food and cut vegetables inside the refrigerator tightly, and keep ready-to-eat dishes stored safely away from raw items.
Clear the handwashing sink of all utensils and cookware so staff always have easy access to soap and running water.
Remove and safely discard the expired ghee, and do a quick routine check of pantry items to ensure everything is fresh.
Wipe down the cooktop surface to remove spills, and give the wooden chopping board a deep clean or consider replacing it.
Place waste inside a sturdy dustbin fitted with a secure lid instead of leaving bags directly on the floor.
hi: फ्रिज में रखे सभी पके हुए भोजन और कटी सब्जियों को अच्छी तरह ढँक कर रखें, तथा पके खाने को कच्चे सामान से अलग रखें।
हाथ धोने वाले सिंक से गंदे बर्तनों को हटा दें, ताकि हाथ धोने के लिए साबुन और साफ पानी हमेशा आसानी से उपलब्ध रहे।
तारीख समाप्त हो चुके (एक्सपायर्ड) घी को तुरंत हटा दें और रसोई के अन्य सामानों की एक्सपायरी तारीख भी नियमित रूप से जाँच लें।
चूल्हे की सतह पर गिरे खाने को साफ करें और लकड़ी के चॉपिंग बोर्ड को अच्छी तरह घिसकर धोएं या जरूरत पड़ने पर बदल लें।
कचरे को सीधे फर्श पर बैग में रखने के बजाय ढक्कन वाले मजबूत डस्टबिन में रखें और ढक्कन बंद रखें।
or: ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ଥିବା ସମସ୍ତ ରନ୍ଧା ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଏବଂ କଟା ପନିପରିବାକୁ ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ରନ୍ଧା ଖାଦ୍ୟକୁ କଞ୍ଚା ଜିନିଷଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ହାତ ଧୋଇବା ସିଙ୍କରୁ ଅଇଁଠା ବାସନଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ହଟାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଯାହାଫଳରେ ସାବୁନ ଏବଂ ସଫା ପାଣିରେ ହାତ ଧୋଇବା ସହଜ ହେବ।
ମିଆଦ ପୂରିଯାଇଥିବା (ଏକ୍ସପାୟାର୍ଡ) ଘିଅକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ବାହାର କରିଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ସାମଗ୍ରୀର ତାରିଖ ନିୟମିତ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ।
ଚୁଲାର ଉପରିଭାଗକୁ ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ପୋଛି ସଫା କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପନିପରିବା କଟା କାଠ ବୋର୍ଡ଼କୁ ଭଲ ଭାବେ ସଫା କରନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଦଳାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
ଚଟାଣ ଉପରେ ପଲିଥିନ୍ ନ ରଖି ଆବର୍ଜନାକୁ ସର୍ବଦା ଢାଙ୍କୁଣୀ ଥିବା ଡଷ୍ଟବିନରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
